research_notes: Follow up missing public-service employers and intervals behind seven-year claim; establish Library and Education hours, employment boundaries, leave and overlap. Reconcile AIEF Pathways/Programs titles and possible 2009 start; obtain primary Kookaburra Kids cessation details.

Initial pass 2026-09-29 checked official parliamentary/member biographies, first speech, public professional profile and departure statement, employer appointment announcement, historical AIEF and school annual reports, and person-specific hours searches. US namesakes excluded. SLQ 2008–09 report download returned 403; LinkedIn profile returned 999; no access controls bypassed.

AIEF 2009 report successfully downloaded and text inspected: printed p.7 has CEO report dated 27 May 2010 and printed p.38 names Pathways Director. First recruitment in August 2009 is organisation-wide, not proof that Coffey commenced then. Retain parliamentary 2010 start pending person-specific evidence.

Explicit full-time AIEF evidence is preserved but does not create public/private headline years because nonprofit employment is excluded. Employment status remains unknown for the multi-year spell since full-time is established only at a 2023 observation, with historical leave and hours still open.

First speech describes six months of full-time campaigning. That does not establish hours in the charity CEO role or a precise resignation date. Public biographies' public-service totals are not substitutes for non-overlapping dated employment spells.

No eligible private-enterprise spell established in this pass; completeness has not been established, so absence of a identified spell is not a zero headline. Blocked initial record requires systematic follow-up.

2026-10-02 follow-up: added2000 commencement for unresolved government-work umbrella,1998 youth founding and separately dated UniSA/UNSW/Stanford study. Seven-year public-service claim still lacks employer-by-employer boundaries and hours. Recovered2008–09 Library annual report but no person match. UQ repository UQ:319766 returned (403) Forbidden;2006 thesis remains a verification lead, not adopted graduation date. Historical2018 professional biography and2020 school profile do not resolve AIEF promotion/start boundaries, government employment conditions or2025 charity cessation. Next: early Queensland departmental staff records, historical Reconciliation SA employment/control and dated public CV. Existing supported facts and null totals retained.

2026-10-03 follow-up: search indexing exposed UQ's primary repository metadata for the 2006 honours thesis and the public LinkedIn profile's January 2004–December 2006 Reconciliation Queensland interval. The latter is coded as volunteering because Coffey's first speech explicitly describes that activity as volunteer work; it is not added to employment totals. The possible 2006 overlap with Reconciliation South Australia remains unresolved. Searches of Queensland Government, State Library, Education, Reconciliation SA, Kookaburra Kids and successor records did not identify the missing departments, public-service hours or exact charity cessation. A March 2025 self-report says she had recently stepped down and names a successor managing director, but no exact cessation day is inferred.

2026-10-04 follow-up (second nationwide pass): employer annual reports materially refine the AIEF title sequence: Programs Director in the 2010 and 2011 reports and Projects Director in 2013, following the 2009 report's Pathways Director listing. These are employer snapshots, not exact promotion dates, hours or proof of a pre-2010 commencement; APH's 2010 overall start remains retained. Kookaburra searches repeated the March 2023 appointment and a March 2025 'recently stepped down' statement without an exact cessation day. Government department identities and person-specific public-service hours remain unresolved.

Targeted follow-up2026-10-05: Original CHAC2021annual report, with board/control pages rendered and visually inspected, resolves board commencement26October2021, voluntary service and nonprofitCollegePtyLtdchurchownership.2021and2024reports name Coffey alumni committee activity; the unnamed2024part-time coordinator and other staff leave rows are not assigned to her. Original OvercomingMS transcript/profile corroborates the existing February2023full-time DeputyCEO observation, but no whole-period hours or parental-leave interval. Government-department identity,2000–2006hours, ReconciliationSAcontrol and Kookaburraactualexit remain unresolved. Clinical/family details omitted as unrelated to employment; case-story authorship is a follow-up lead without inferred pay.
